name: the face's vendored document renderers and type
policy: Pinned, offline-capable, lazy-loaded per format. Never a CDN at render time. Each entry: version, upstream, the exact download URL, the SHA-256 of the vendored file, the SPDX license, and the reason. Re-verify provenance with shasum -a 256.

entries.name: DOMPurify
entries.reason: The sanitizer between document-derived HTML and the pane's DOM (markdown hardening, D2).

entries.name: PDF.js
entries.reason: PDF rendering inside the fence (D3): the sandbox disables the browser's native viewer, so the fence chooses PDF.js — API mode, scripting disabled, the document as data.

entries.name: PDF.js worker
entries.reason: PDF.js's parse worker — the pair with pdf.min.mjs, one version pin.

entries.name: docx-preview
entries.reason: DOCX rendering (D5) — runs inside the sandboxed frame, its output never touches the app's origin.

entries.name: JSZip
entries.reason: docx-preview's dependency, the zip reader the DOCX render needs inside the frame.

entries.name: Space Grotesk
entries.reason: The U6 display voice (U-ledger): brand, headings, object titles. Latin variable subset; the stack after it is the degradation path, never a second voice. Served from the binary — the face fetches nothing (hard rule 12).

entries.name: Inter
entries.reason: The U6 body voice: prose, controls, labels. Latin variable subset; served from the binary (hard rule 12).

entries.name: JetBrains Mono
entries.reason: The U6 data voice: tags, timestamps, gauges, micro-labels. Latin variable subset; served from the binary (hard rule 12).

entries.name: BoopFace (the persona faces)
entries.license: MIT (the license does not transfer the BoopFace name or the character identity - fleet vendors the software, presents its own personas, and never names the upstream character in product copy)
entries.reason: The persona faces (the harness redesign A1-A5): expressive robot faces for the roster, tinted from the token chain at runtime. The lite graph ships - every expression, no skins (D8: skins stay off; the painters in the full build are not vendored).

entries.name: marked
entries.reason: Markdown rendering (the UX map study's R6): the preview renders CommonMark/GFM the hand-rolled parser only approximated. Its output is HTML, so it is sanitised by the vendored DOMPurify before it touches the DOM; a build without the sanitiser refuses the render.

entries.name: PPTXjs
entries.reason: PPTX rendering (the UX map study's R8): slides drawn as HTML/SVG inside the sandboxed frame from the document's bytes in memory, no network and no worker. fflate is inlined in this bundle (single runtime dep upstream). The text-outline renderer stays the named fallback when the viewer reports an error.
